bodyHtml.zh-CN:
产品改进

  • 新增 OMP CLI 提供商注册、按提供商回退模型和 CLI 版本解析优化。
  • 新增 UserPoints 成就与实时薪资追踪，并支持 HagiTask 预设组和运行时 vault 配置。
  • 新增开发 DLC 头像支持，并保留仅包含空白的流式内容。

问题修复

  • 移除提案词云和内置 task-preset 插件文件。
bodyHtml.en:
Product Improvements

  • Added OMP CLI provider registration with provider-scoped model fallback and improved CLI version detection.
  • Added UserPoints achievements and a real-time salary tracker, plus support for HagiTask preset groups and runtime vault configuration.
  • Added hero avatar development DLC support and preserved whitespace-only streaming content.

Fixes

  • Removed the proposal word cloud and bundled task-preset plugin files.
